Experiment path

From images to scores

  1. 01Eye-image folders

    Four folder-defined classes; source and licensing are undocumented.

  2. 02Feature pipeline

    EfficientNetB0, global pooling, and an untrained 512-unit projection layer.

  3. 03Template transform

    IoM hashing, BioHashing, or 128-dimensional random projection.

  4. 04Classification

    Random Forest, RBF SVM, KNN, and XGBoost with three-fold tuning.

Responsible interpretation

What this output does—and does not—show

Classification

Not biometric verification

The notebook does not report FAR, FRR, EER, ROC, unlinkability, irreversibility, or revocability.

Method

No diffusion model

Despite the repository name, the current implementation uses EfficientNet features and classical classifiers.

Reproducibility

Dataset required

Colab can open the code, but rerunning it requires the original dataset and significant compute.
